stem: Which sentence best supports the idea that hammocks have been used to help solve a problem?

options.label: F
options.text: The Taino made the hammocks by weaving together cotton, plant fibers, and tree bark. (paragraph 2)

options.label: G
options.text: Columbus admired how the hanging beds kept sleepers safe from the soggy ground and pesky forest animals. (paragraph 3)

options.label: H
options.text: Gonzalo Fernández de Oviedo y Valdés was another explorer who was fascinated by hammocks. (paragraph 4)

options.label: J
options.text: Today hammocks are not just for relaxing. (paragraph 7)
